limitations: No onset picks, tide subtraction, interpolation or ETA alignment.
Provider IDs and filename codes do not validate historical deployments.
Numeric sentinel conventions are unverified; finite numbers remain unchanged.
Duplicate timestamps remain separate source rows; observation IDs may repeat.
Intervals above nominal cadence can include timing jitter; only CO-OPS has missing-grid counts.
Display coverage is an operational 36-hour/80-percent/60-minute rule, not a scientific validation gate.
